I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when a car came into my lane on a slight curve and we collided head-on.
Both of us were moving slowly, I think under twenty miles per hour, but the impact pushed my head back and then
forward, and my airbag did not deploy. I stayed at the scene until the officer arrived and I told the same account to
him, to the other driver, and later to the adjuster on the phone, with no changes to the sequence of events. I have
been the named driver on this policy for several years and I have held continuous coverage with the company
throughout. Since the collision I have had stiffness and soreness in my neck and lower back, and I have been seeing
a physical therapist twice a week to manage the strain. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed,
and I am willing to provide any further records needed.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
